entry.title: Refactor your code - refactor yourself & 30 years PHP, 20 years CakePHP
entry.content:
Talk 1: Refactor your code - refactor yourself

Mindset for refactoring projects and personal growth. Looking at old legacy code, you usually know 'a better way to do it' by now.

by Peter Dietrich

Talk 2: 30 years PHP, 20 years CakePHP

PHP and CakePHP's evolution in web development. Includes live demo of CakePHP's capabilities.

by Mark Scherer
